name: Cleaner
description: Free space from caches, logs, leftovers and old downloads. Everything goes to the Trash.
whatsNew: Explains itself on its page in Settings.

howTo.goal: Frees up space by finding caches, logs, leftovers from removed apps and old downloads.
rules: Scan, tick what you want gone, then move it to the Trash.
Nothing is deleted outright; the Trash keeps it until you empty it.
A reminder below can tell you now and then how much could be cleaned.
